expect.notes: The --resume argument is captured: the driver passes sessions.main.resume and asserts the fake's captured value equals it. --resume of a missing session gives a pre-init result (error_during_execution, num_turns 0, errors 'No conversation found ...') that echoes the requested UUID. A pre-init rejection never confirms identity or opens (C2 §2 delayed identity); the definite, fixture-backed missing-session rejection is StartRejected::SessionGone and the same VIA session is kept (packet §2). No init was read, so vendor_version is null (C2 §5).
